```sql
SELECT *
FROM (
  SELECT t.*,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY order_id
           ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC
         ) AS rn
  FROM orders t
) x
WHERE rn = 1;
```
